title: Compound Boolean Assertions in Test Suites
pattern: Combining multiple independent correctness checks into a single compound boolean expression within an assertion macro.
why_bad: When the test fails, the testing framework only outputs "assertion failed: true == false," completely concealing which of the variables (`a` or `c`) caused the failure, making diagnostics difficult.
detection: An `assert!` macro containing logical AND (`&&`) operators separating distinct equality checks.
